company.name: StackLead
company.shortDescription: StackLead uses data-aggregation technology to help add every open role in the world to LinkedIn.
company.description:
StackLead enables sales teams to automatically qualify and assign their sales leads. It offers a lead processing engine that collects and structures data across the web and merges disparate information to qualify and prioritize sales leads.

StackLead was launched in 2014 by Ted Tomlinson and Gordon Wintrob. It is operated from San Francisco, California.
